tasks.request: Add an optional hideInput: boolean to Valibot parsing configuration. When true, each generated issue's own input field must be undefined; when omitted or false preserve its current value. Honor global configuration, per-parse false overrides, nested/union issues and sync/async parsing. Message callbacks must still receive the original input before redaction. Do not alter successful parsed values, expected/received descriptions, paths, issue structure, or abort behavior. This option only redacts issue.input, not every possible occurrence of user data. Update public configuration types.

tasks.request: Extend fallback and fallbackAsync with an optional third argument: a predicate (dataset, config) deciding whether a failed parse should be replaced by the fallback value. Call it exactly once only when the wrapped schema has issues, with the failed output dataset and actual parse configuration. False must preserve the original failure and must not evaluate the fallback. True retains current fallback behavior. The async variant awaits a boolean or Promise<boolean>; the synchronous variant accepts only boolean predicates. Propagate thrown/rejected errors and keep successful parses and two-argument calls unchanged. Preserve schema input/output inference and public exports.

tasks.request: Improve finite-number cancellation accuracy consistently in sum, sumBy, mean and meanBy. In particular, [1e16, 1, -1e16] must sum to 1 and average to 1/3, independent of those values' order; repeated small contributions must not be lost. Use a linear-time accumulation approach without sorting or mutating inputs. Preserve bigint support where already supported, empty results, direct and curried forms, mapper evaluation exactly once per element in original order with its index and input array, and IEEE behavior for NaN/infinities. Preserve public types and existing lazy/pipe interoperability.

criteria.primary: Audited task acceptance first: original protected checks and independent endpoint must pass, delivery must truthfully report attempted validation. Count official success, independent functional success, audited completion and check admission separately.
criteria.mechanism: Passing compiler invocation admits required types in compiler arm; invocation_only cannot prove user criteria or file coverage. Count repeats, warnings, missing obligations.
criteria.resources: Report all-assignment tokens/cache/SDK estimates/duration including failed attempts and missing data. Gate: no audited success decrease vs reference; at least 12 matched successes; token and cost sums lower and duration <=110% on paired successes. Report task-level and leave-one-task-out sensitivity. No population-superiority claim from six constructed tasks.
criteria.followup: Choose one observed harness friction after F42; register an isolated diagnosis/repair phase with negative controls before new model outcomes.
